report: Issue #1440: post_bot_commits (and coupled POSTBOT_SHAS + cheap-gate.jq field comment) narrowed to count only positively human-attributable non-merge post-bot commits; new ends_bot/is_human jq defs are null-safe (type=="string" guard before endswith/test) so blank/whitespace/absent/non-string logins are classified agent-side and no longer abort the filter. Both iteration-1 Important test-gaps are FIXED at 200718b26: two one-sided OR-arm fixtures (blank-author/human-committer -> 1; human-author/blank-committer -> 1) that flip RED if either is_human OR arm is dropped, plus a coupled one-sided POSTBOT_SHAS fixture, plus a PR-author self-exclusion fixture. The run.sh harness extracts-and-executes the SHIPPED jq blocks (grep/sed anchored to distinct terminators) rather than transcribing a copy, and fails closed (RED) on empty/truncated extraction via the added extract-cleanly asserts and the fixture rows. Coupled-mirror discipline holds across the three sites; portability sound ([^[:space:]] POSIX class, no GNU-only constructs); adversarial input-shape matrix well covered. Remaining items are all Suggestions/advisory: (1) is_human's `!= $author` clause is structurally anchor-unreachable from the tail (defense-in-depth; the self-exclusion fixture passes via the anchor's `== $author`, which the run.sh comment accurately states as hedged) -- a known, accepted disposition, not a new defect; (2) fetch-pr-context.sh 'anchor unchanged' wording is slightly imprecise since null-safety changed anchor behavior on null logins (behavior-inert); (3) extract-cleanly guards check substring presence only, with a remote theoretical EOF-capture gap (test-harness only). None reach the REJECT threshold.

phase3_findings.summary: is_human's `!= $author` clause is structurally unreachable from the tail; the self-exclusion fixture yields 0 via the anchor `== $author`, not via the clause. Comment is accurately hedged (backs it up / defense-in-depth) per comment-analyzer, so this is documentation-of-a-known-disposition, not a new defect. Optional: reword to name the anchor as the enforcing mechanism or drop the redundant clause.

'The last bot commit anchor (below) is unchanged' is easy to misread: the anchor select lines were rewritten to route through ends_bot(), and null/non-string logins that previously aborted the filter now evaluate false in the anchor too. Behavior-inert wording nit; consider 'anchor definition unchanged (now null-safe)'.

extract-cleanly guards check only substring presence (*POST_BOT_COMMITS=*), not well-formedness; a remote terminator-format change could over-capture to EOF and still emit a right value. The coupled fixtures make an actual behavior drift RED, so this is a note; test-harness only.
